data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6103 reported a net release of GBP 1.342m in prior year reserves for the 2019 calendar year, primarily driven by favorable development on the 2018 underwriting year. The 2017 underwriting year contributed a loss of GBP 0.541m, while the 2018 underwriting year contributed a profit of GBP 1.883m. Although 2018 saw hurricanes Florence and Michael and California Wildfires, these events did not lead to adverse development beyond normal uncertainty. Gross premiums written for 2019 totaled GBP 21.040m, entirely from reinsurance business.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported as a net figure from the annual accounted profit breakdown by underwriting year, as no gross prior year development figure was explicitly stated or reliably calculable from the claims development triangle. Gross premium mix inferred from narrative stating the syndicate's principal activity is writing reinsurance business, as no segmental analysis table was provided.
